Stock for Bundles Full Stock in South America

1790 pieces available · Bundle pricing

Tap any shirt to select it. Your running total appears at the bottom — the more pieces you add, the lower the price of every piece. Send us the reference codes of the shirts you like.

Shipping budget. Delivery is made by DHL International and is quoted on the total weight of your parcel. Since the shipping fee increases only slightly with each extra piece, larger bundles make the most of it — the more pieces you select, the lower the shipping cost per piece.

100% authenticity-checked. Every piece in this stock has already been checked for authenticity. A small share of items made in South America (local manufacturing runs) can show minor differences from the better-known European versions — these are genuine regional productions, not defects.

Video Quality Check. Before dispatch, every shirt goes through a Quality Check on video, so you can confirm it is in the exact condition you expected. At this stage, any piece can be swapped for another one from the stock.

Bundle pricing

Prices shown are per piece for 1–5 pieces. As your bundle grows, every piece in it gets cheaper, step by step: from 6 pieces each one is reduced by €10, from 10 by €16, from 15 by €20, from 20 by €23, from 25 by €25, from 30 by €27, from 35 by €28, from 40 by €29, from 45 by €30, from 50 by €31 and from 55 pieces by €32. The reduction applies to the whole bundle, not only to the extra pieces.
